title: FROZEN REDRAW STAYS STEADY
why: Two spare PC checks (9.07, 33.51) failed only on the slow machine: a redraw of a frozen frame fed the auto resolution window with a stale frame gap, so the scale could move between two redraws. Redraws with no clock step no longer steer quality.
now: A redraw that does not advance the clock never changes the auto resolution.
